versions.changelog:
Initial release: Generate a business opportunity skills report with full-page screenshot.

- Searches for business opportunity–related skills via ClawHub API (auto-fallback to preset list on failure)
- Produces a categorized, visually formatted HTML report
- Launches Chromium to render the report and captures a full-page screenshot
- Allows custom search keywords and output file naming
- Outputs both the HTML report file and JPG screenshot for easy sharing
